name: Banh cong
summary: Bánh cống is a savoury fritter of mung bean, taro, and rice flour, topped with a whole shrimp. Vietnam Tourism’s dining chapter says it is popular in Can Tho and Soc Trang and eaten with herbs as an afternoon snack.
origin: Can Tho and Soc Trang, in the Mekong dining chapter. The Soc Trang half is the neighbor.
howToEat: Two or three, with herbs, in the afternoon.
where: Can Tho. A shop street was not printed.
seoDescription: A savoury shrimp fritter of mung bean, taro, and rice flour, popular in Can Tho and Soc Trang on Vietnam Tourism’s dining chapter.
